title: From sketch to *gold*
hero_alt: Amber line drawing of a strand of Lune beads, Disque spacers and Colonne pipes
dek: How a bead becomes a bracelet, in three steps.

body.html: Every part in our library started as a drawing. Before a bead is cut, we draw it facet by facet, so we know how it will catch the light and how it will sit against its neighbours.

The drawing becomes a precise model, checked to a fraction of a millimetre so that beads, pipes and spacers sit flush once strung. Only then is the part made in 916 gold, cut, polished and strung into a design.

body.text: A bead that is a hair too wide shows as a gap on the wrist.

body.html: The same care goes into the designs you create with us. Choose your parts from the library, and we will draw, model and string them into a bracelet sized to your wrist.
